quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026) results release: consolidated revenue NT$1,270.38 billion (+36.0% year-over-year, +12.0% versus Q1 2026); in US dollars revenue was $40.20 billion (+33.7% year-over-year). Net income NT$706.56 billion and diluted EPS NT$27.25 (US$4.31 per ADR unit), both +77.4% year-over-year. Gross margin 67.7%, operating margin 60.3%, net profit margin 55.6%. Wafer revenue by node: 2-nanometer 3%, 3-nanometer 30%, 5-nanometer 33%, 7-nanometer 11%; advanced technologies (7-nanometer and more advanced) 77% of total wafer revenue.

quarterly_data.signal: Q3 2026 guidance (management, based on the current business outlook): revenue between US$44.6 billion and US$45.8 billion; based on an exchange rate assumption of 1 US dollar to 32 NT dollars, gross profit margin between 65% and 67% and operating profit margin between 56% and 58%. CFO Wendell Huang: 'Moving into third quarter 2026, we expect our business to be supported by continued strong demand for our leading-edge process technologies, including the steep ramp-up of our 2-nanometer technology.'
